Bounces on hits or surfaces and seeks up to 9 enemies within ? meters of each, dealing <pve 427 /> <pvp [82] /> damage and <strand Severing /> the target for ?+? seconds on hit.

Deals 18% decreased damage on the first bounce and 42.5% decreased damage on each bounce afterwards.

Grants Melee Energy based on the number of hits scored before returning. [Melee Attack] while the projectile is nearby to catch it for more Melee Energy.
• 0 hits: 5% (20% when caught)
• 1 hit: 10% (30% when caught)
• 2 hits: 20% (50% when caught)
• 3 hits: 30% (70% when caught)
• 4 hits: 35% (85% when caught)
• 5+ hits: 40% (100% when caught)

On the <strand Strand /> subclass, catching the Threaded Spike grants <strand Woven Mail /> for 2 seconds for each kill it scores, up to 10 seconds.

source.text:
Bounces on hits or upon striking surfaces, heading towards up to 9 enemies within ? metres of each, dealing 427 [82] damage and severing for ?+? seconds on hit. 
Deals 18% decreased damage on the first bounce, and 42.5% decreased damage on every bounce afterwards.

Grants Melee Energy based on the amount of hits scored upon returning.
[Melee Attack] while the projectile is nearby to catch it. 
Catching the Threaded Spike increases the amount of Melee Energy gained.
Strand Subclass Exclusive: Catching the Threaded Spike grants Woven Mail for 2 seconds for each kill it scores, up to a maximum of 10 seconds.
